sources.label: legendsciber's Patches - Morphe patches
sources.author: legendsciber
patch_list: Disables ads completely: EnableAD always returns false, interstitials and banners are no-ops, Adjust purchase verification is skipped.
Rewarded ads always count as loaded and WatchVideo grants the success callback immediately without playing an ad, including offline.
Unlocks VIP permanently: EnableVIP always reports true, unsubscribe and subscription refresh can no longer clear the flag.
